verdicts.reason: A is not a resize at all. It is the original shrunk and centred, with large empty white areas on both sides, and 'EVERYONE IS WELCOME!' becomes tiny, hard-to-read text. B rearranges properly into a banner, with the photo on the left and a clear, readable headline and subhead on the right, but it has flaws. The cloud shape that blended into the photo is now a faint grey outline that looks like an artefact. The photo sits against the left edge with uneven gaps above and below. The right half reads as plain white with no link to the photo.
